SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEP_SEQ FROM kep.IF_FILE_UC WHERE BUYER = 'KRKEPB0004' AND DOC_TYPE = 'IVHD' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY KEP_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT key_no as LEGACY_INV_NO , data01 as INV_SUBJECT , f_split(data02,'^',1) as INV_DATE , f_split(data02,'^',2) as INV_ADD_DATE , f_split(data03,'^',1) as INV_USER_NM , f_split(data03,'^',2) as INV_CAR_NO , f_split(data03,'^',3) as INV_USER_TEL , data04 as INV_STATUS FROM kep.IF_FILE_UC WHERE KEP_SEQ = $G_RS.KEP_SEQ$
UPDATE kep.IF_FILE_UC SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(sysdate,'HH24MISS') WHERE KEP_SEQ = $G_RS.KEP_SEQ$
UPDATE kep.IF_FILE_UC SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(sysdate,'HH24MISS') WHERE KEP_SEQ = $G_RS.KEP_SEQ$
